title: The Oscars Lowrider Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not available for children who need car seats
policies: Travel time included in total tour duration
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Kick off your Los Angeles adventure with an unforgettable tour in a classic '64 Impala lowrider! Begin your journey at the iconic Beverly Hills sign and step into a piece of automotive history. Cruise through LA in style and view the glamorous streets of Beverly Hills.

You’ll see the city’s most luxurious mansions & landmarks. Along the way, we stop at scenic spots perfect for snapping photos, so you can take home a piece of the experience.

Head toward Hollywood on Sunset Boulevard, passing through the heart of LA’s entertainment scene. Visit Hollywood’s Walk of Fame, where you can see the stars up close & find your favorites.

Finish with stunning views from Mulholland Drive, a breathtaking overlook of the cityscape. This tour blends LA’s iconic sights with the classic cool of a vintage lowrider—a Los Angeles experience you won’t forget!

Looking for a more personalized experience? We offer private tours tailored just for you! Reach out and we’ll craft you an unforgettable LA tour.
